close_reason: Two-pass role-swap comment verified and strengthened: added explicit mention of HashMap iteration order undefined and RFC 8621 §2.5 reference
description: handle_mailbox_set splits the update map into (vacating, non_vacating) and runs vacating patches (role: null) in pass 1 before role-claiming patches in pass 2. It also tracks roles_actually_vacated only from successful vacates, so a failed vacate does not release the role. A contributor might simplify to a single iteration, but that would make it impossible to swap roles in a single request — the order of iteration over a HashMap is undefined, so either the vacate or the claim might run first, and if the claim runs first it would be rejected. The two-pass approach is the only correct way to implement atomic role swaps per RFC 8621 §2.5.
title: Mailbox/set update uses two-pass loop to allow role swaps in a single request
